oncall-bot: PagerDuty alert P-1423 -> inference-runtime-high-error-rate triggered for prod-us-east-1 at 2026-09-12T01:12:25Z. Impact: increased 5xxs on /v1/generate. Paging eng-oncall rotation.
ashley: I’m on it, pulling logs now.
dmitri: joining — will check KV cache metrics and batch size spikes.
kevin: grabbing recent deploys, any canary today?
ashley: no canary; there was an autoscaler tweak at 00:40 that raised max batch window.
lina_pm: Customer impact: 3 enterprise tenants saw elevated latencies and occasional failed requests. CS notified.
sre-ops: Observed kvcache hit-rate drop from 96% -> 62% around 01:10. Also saw queue depth spike.
dmitri: looks like KV shards started thrashing; eviction count jumped. Possible regressed quant builds?
ashley: stack traces show retries bubbling up: "KVCacheMissException" in runtime/kv_cache.cc:178
sue: adding logs: ```
[01:09:42] kv::shard_3 evict_count=1245 miss_rate=0.44
[01:10:03] runtime batch window increased from 8ms -> 50ms
[01:10:18] model quantized-worker-2 restarted (OOM)
```
dmitri: hmm model restart could be from quantization path being heavier in mem. If batch window grew, usage pattern changed which bumped KV working set.
kevin: action: scale up cache nodes by +1 and temporarily revert batch window change to 12ms. I’ll run scale now.
ashley: go for it. I’ll flip config after kevin confirms scale success.
kevin: scaling cache-pool-prod by 1 — `./infra scale --pool cache-pool-prod --delta 1`
kevin: scaled, new instances booting, health checks passing (03/03).
ashley: reverted batch window to 12ms in runtime config: `deploy config/runtime.yaml -> batch_window_ms: 12`
dmitri: seeing kvcache hit-rate climbing back to 88% and 5xxs decreasing. Latency back to baseline ~120ms.
lina_pm: CS updated customers with mitigation note; preparing postmortem invite.
sre-ops: leaving a bookmark: incident timeline + graphs -> https://redwood.internal/ops/incidents/P-1423 (internal)
ashley: recommend post-incident: (1) revert autoscaler heuristics until canary (2) add guardrail on batch_window max value (3) investigate quantized model memory regression, tie to recent model packaging change.
dmitri: also add a KV cache eviction alert earlier threshold (hit-rate < 80%) and a preemptive scale policy when working_set_growth > 20%/5m.
kevin: I’ll open infra PR for guardrail and auto-scaler rollback steps.
sue: I’ll own the model packaging investigation — starting bisect on quant build changelist.
lina_pm: scheduling postmortem. Proposed time: 2026-09-12 15:00 UTC. Invite will include eng-runtime, eng-ml, infra, product.
ashley: +1. Please include the troubleshooting checklist and customer impact summary.
dmitri: assigning action items: `A1` infra PR for guardrail (kevin), `A2` kvcache alert + autoscale policy (dmitri), `A3` quant-build bisect + repro (sue), `A4` postmortem doc (lina_pm).
kevin: noted A1, will link PR here when ready: https://git.internal/rw/infra/pulls/4828
sre-ops: tagging follow-up task in tracker: RW-OPS-9876 (post-incident remediation).
lina_pm: postmortem doc created: https://docs.internal/postmortems/P-1423 (will add runbook changes).
sue: initial bisect found one suspicious packaging change in CL 3267 (layer norm dtype casting). Investigating further.
dmitri: temporary mitigations: new kvcache scaling rule deployed, batch window guardrail queued in infra PR. Recommend canary this week for autoscaler tweak.
ashley: closing pager — services stable and customer-facing errors resolved. If anything flares up re-open. :white_check_mark:
lina_pm: thank you team. Please update the postmortem doc with notes and mark actions done as completed.
kevin: PR opened https://git.internal/rw/infra/pulls/4830 -> guardrail added, will request review.
sue: will post bisect results by EOD.
dmitri: assigning owners in tracker: RW-OPS-9876 -> A1:kevin, A2:dmitri, A3:sue, A4:lina_pm.
ashley: tagging priority: P2 remediation. Follow-up sync tomorrow 10:00 UTC.
lina_pm: invite sent.
ashley: final note: consider adding a small chaos test covering batch-window + kvcache interaction in CI to catch this pattern earlier.
sre-ops: noted, adding to ops backlog.
kevin: thanks all.
